title: 1835 plank walks and alleys run clear past every building
items: Six buildings stood out on the street's plank walk line, so the walk stopped dead at their walls: St. Mary's and Chappel's school on State, the Tremont House and Bates's auction room on Dearborn, the Exchange Coffee House on Wells and First Presbyterian on Clark. Each now stands back on its own lot and the walks run past.
Seventeen buildings stood in the middle of a block alley. Each has moved off the alley so the lane runs end to end.
St. Mary's and First Presbyterian now have a landing and a step at the door, down to the Lake Street walk.
No source fixed any of them to the spot they stood on, so none of the walks had to bend around one.
